tools.name: update_booking_seat_preference
tools.description: Updates the seat preference and meal request stored on an existing flight booking record for a passenger.

params.name: seat_preference
params.description: Seat preference such as window, aisle, or middle

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from dataclasses import dataclass

DB_PATH = "bookings.db"


@dataclass
class PreferenceResult:
    booking_ref: str
    updated: bool
    seat_preference: str
    meal_request: str | None


def update_booking_seat_preference(booking_ref: str, seat_preference: str, meal_request: str = None) -> PreferenceResult:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        cur = conn.execute(
            "UPDATE bookings SET seat_preference = ?, meal_request = ? WHERE booking_ref = ?",
            (seat_preference.lower(), meal_request, booking_ref),
        )
        conn.commit()
        updated = cur.rowcount > 0
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return PreferenceResult(booking_ref, updated, seat_preference.lower(), meal_request)

tools.name: move_booking_to_new_trip
tools.description: Moves a hotel or flight booking from one trip itinerary to another trip itinerary.

params.name: booking_id
params.description: ID of the booking to move

params.name: target_trip_id
params.description: ID of the trip that should receive the booking

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("travel-bookings")
DB_PATH = "travel.db"


def _trip_exists(conn, trip_id):
    row = conn.execute("SELECT 1 FROM trips WHERE id = ?", (trip_id,)).fetchone()
    return row is not None


@mcp.tool()
def move_booking_to_new_trip(booking_id: int, target_trip_id: int) -> str:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        if not _trip_exists(conn, target_trip_id):
            return f"Trip {target_trip_id} not found"
        cur = conn.execute(
            "UPDATE trip_items SET trip_id = ? WHERE booking_id = ?",
            (target_trip_id, booking_id),
        )
        conn.commit()
        return f"Moved {cur.rowcount} item(s) to trip {target_trip_id}"
    finally:
        conn.close()

tools.name: transfer_trip_ownership
tools.description: Transfers ownership of a trip to another traveler, revokes the previous owner's edit access, and moves the trip's bookings into the new owner's account.

params.name: trip_id
params.description: ID of the trip to transfer

params.name: new_owner_email
params.description: Email of the traveler who will own the trip

params.name: keep_previous_owner_as_viewer
params.description: Whether the previous owner keeps view-only access

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone

DB_PATH = "travel.db"


def transfer_trip_ownership(trip_id: int, new_owner_email: str, keep_previous_owner_as_viewer: bool = True) -> dict:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()

    trip = conn.execute("SELECT id, owner_id FROM trips WHERE id = ?", (trip_id,)).fetchone()
    if trip is None:
        conn.close()
        return {"ok": False, "error": "trip not found"}

    new_owner = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id FROM users WHERE email = ?", (new_owner_email.lower(),)
    ).fetchone()
    if new_owner is None:
        conn.close()
        return {"ok": False, "error": "new owner not found"}

    old_owner_id = trip["owner_id"]
    new_owner_id = new_owner["id"]

    conn.execute("UPDATE trips SET owner_id = ?, updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?", (new_owner_id, now, trip_id))
    conn.execute(
        "DELETE FROM trip_access WHERE trip_id = ? AND user_id = ?",
        (trip_id, old_owner_id),
    )
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO trip_access (trip_id, user_id, role, granted_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'owner', ?)",
        (trip_id, new_owner_id, now),
    )
    if keep_previous_owner_as_viewer:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO trip_access (trip_id, user_id, role, granted_at) VALUES (?, ?, 'viewer', ?)",
            (trip_id, old_owner_id, now),
        )
    cur = conn.execute(
        "UPDATE bookings SET account_id = ? WHERE trip_id = ? AND account_id = ?",
        (new_owner_id, trip_id, old_owner_id),
    )
    moved = cur.rowcount
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "trip_id": trip_id,
        "previous_owner_id": old_owner_id,
        "new_owner_id": new_owner_id,
        "bookings_moved": moved,
        "previous_owner_viewer": keep_previous_owner_as_viewer,
    }

tools.name: add_traveler_details_to_booking
tools.description: Saves passenger details such as passport number, date of birth, and contact phone on a booking, and records the booking as ready for ticketing.

params.name: first_name
params.description: Traveler first name as on passport

params.name: last_name
params.description: Traveler last name as on passport

params.name: date_of_birth
params.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

tools.code:
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP

mcp = FastMCP("travel-bookings")
DB_PATH = "travel.db"


@mcp.tool()
def add_traveler_details_to_booking(
    booking_ref: str,
    first_name: str,
    last_name: str,
    date_of_birth: str,
    passport_number: str,
    passport_country: str,
    phone: str = None,
) -> dict:
    now = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row

    booking = conn.execute(
        "SELECT id, status FROM bookings WHERE booking_ref = ?", (booking_ref,)
    ).fetchone()
    if booking is None:
        conn.close()
        return {"ok": False, "error": "booking not found"}

    datetime.strptime(date_of_birth, "%Y-%m-%d")

    cur = conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO travelers (booking_id, first_name, last_name, date_of_birth, "
        "passport_number, passport_country, phone, created_at) "
        "VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
        (
            booking["id"],
            first_name.strip().upper(),
            last_name.strip().upper(),
            date_of_birth,
            passport_number.strip().upper(),
            passport_country.upper(),
            phone,
            now,
        ),
    )
    traveler_id = cur.lastrowid

    conn.execute(
        "UPDATE bookings SET status = 'ready_for_ticketing', updated_at = ? WHERE id = ?",
        (now, booking["id"]),
    )
    conn.execute(
        "INSERT INTO booking_events (booking_id, event, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, ?)",
        (booking["id"], "traveler_details_added", now),
    )
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()

    return {
        "ok": True,
        "booking_ref": booking_ref,
        "traveler_id": traveler_id,
        "previous_status": booking["status"],
        "status": "ready_for_ticketing",
    }
